LanguageData.SEC_PlayerFaction.label: Secretary Nexus
LanguageData.SEC_PlayerFaction.description: This is the settlement of secretaries.
LanguageData.SEC_Faction_AlfausUnion.label: Union of All Alfaus Clans
LanguageData.SEC_Faction_AlfausUnion.description: The Union of All Alfaus Clans is the only political organization that nominally unifies the entire Alfaus civilization. From the end of the Unification Wars thousands of years ago to the present day, centuries after stepping into the sea of stars, it has grown into a behemoth that spans hundreds of star systems and shelters hundreds of millions of clans. Yet, as the Alfaus continue to expand across the star sea, the Union has become increasingly loose. Although a great deal of administrative work has been delegated to computers or the Secretary Nexus, when it comes to responding to new changes, enacting new laws, and coordinating economic cooperation across ever‑larger ranges, it has become difficult to reach effective consensus in a timely manner at the Union‑wide level. Therefore, for the vast majority of Alfaus and those aliens truly accepted into Alfaus society, actual political life takes place within smaller sub‑unions that cover only several to a few dozen star systems, and the delegates to the Supreme Assembly of the Union of All Alfaus Clans are typically elected from these smaller clan unions.\n\nThe Alfaus colonists come to the rimworld are such a small clan union. As a newly formed union, it was founded less than a decade ago. Its members come from several habitable star systems in relatively close proximity. It possesses no grand space fleet, no cutting‑edge scientific achievements — only modest assistance from the Secretary Nexus and an older, established clan union that seeks to expand its influence through this new union. In order to gain as much manpower, resources, and political influence as possible without touching the interests of other clans, it can only turn its sights to this "unclaimed" rimworld, trying to find new opportunities in this remote corner of the galaxy.
LanguageData.SEC_Faction_Local_Secretary_Nexus.label: Local Secretary Nexus
LanguageData.SEC_Faction_Local_Secretary_Nexus.descri: Secretaries who established local nexus on their own due to far from the core regions of the Alfaus civilization with developed infrastructure. As the pioneer of Alfaus and the Progressive International, they arrived on this rimworld ahead of the rest, gradually terraforming the planet according to pre‑set protocols, building infrastructure, eliminating hostile native lifeforms, and stockpiling supplies for production and life. Now the first wave of Alfaus colonists has arrived, and more colony ships will land in the coming decades. Once the infrastructure is complete and the Alfaus population is sufficient to take over the entire planet, the secretaries will leave this world for the next rimworld, leaving behind only a small number of secretaries to provide essential services.
